# T2.1 — Parse the config file into the settings struct

## Spec

Read a config file at startup and populate the T1 settings struct from it. A
missing file is not an error: fall back to defaults.

## Scope

Parsing and population. Watching the file for changes is T2.2.

## Acceptance

- A file on disk changes the daemon's behaviour without recompiling.
- A missing file leaves every setting at its default.
- A malformed file fails with an error naming the offending key, not a panic.

## Note

This is the fixture's frontier: its only blocker, T1, is `done`, so it is what
`tp task next` returns and the only task `ready --count-eligible` counts.
